## BFS — 02 Query

### How it works

1. Triggers the workflow via a webhook.
2. Checks for user request escalation.
3. Routes the request to AI based on input.
4. Processes the request across RAG-listed domains.
5. Logs the request outcome and responds.
6. Manages error and fallbacks in responses.

### Setup steps

- [ ] Configure webhook trigger for your specific endpoint.
- [ ] Set up OpenAI credentials for AI processing.
- [ ] Ensure Supabase is configured for data storage and retrieval.
- [ ] Establish connections to BFS - 03 Logging and BFS - 05 Escalation sub-workflows.

## Trigger and initial setup

Starts the workflow and sets initial state.

## Request escalation handling

Classifies and directs escalation requests.

## User request escalation process

Handles user escalation requests and responses.

## AI routing process

Routes messages through AI for processing.

## Switch and decision making

Handles decision making for different branches based on AI results.

## Embeddings processing

Processes embeddings using OpenAI for various tasks.

## Legal process path

Processes and responds to legal domain queries.

## HR process path

Processes and responds to HR-related queries.

## Support process path

Processes and responds to support-related queries.

## Fallback responses

Handles fallback responses when no suitable path is found.

=Classify the following user message into exactly one category: legal, hr, support, or none.

- legal: contracts, policies, regulations, legal documents
- hr: employees, hiring, vacation, salary, work policy, remote work
- support: product questions, how-to, troubleshooting, pricing
- none: anything unrelated to the above categories

The message can be in any language. Classify based on the topic, not the language.

Respond with only one word — the category name, nothing else.
